Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed every six 
months or when damages occur on any part as indicated by M6 in the title block
This document used for the following cranes:
Crane | Capacity | Type | Manufacturer
10 Ton Crane | 10 Ton | I & C | Demag Austria
88 Ton Crane | 88 Ton | I & C | Elin Austria
Intake Gate Crane | 150 ton | I & C | Elin Austria
Power House Crane | 265 ton | I & C | Elin Austria
Racking Machine |  |  | Waagner-Biro Austria
The crane 150 
 ton 
 used for lifting and lowering the bulkhead gates in 
 the front of intake gates of the turbine unites.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Zakaria Mohamed

 Haseb Hesain Bahboh, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abd

 by

Safety 
Precautions
A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves
A 
work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, belts, work gloves
Turn off electric power to crane before maintenance 
proceeding
Tools 
and Equipment
Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Personal safety equipment, safety goggles, and rubber gloves and rubber apron.
Digital multi-meter.
Hand held radio wave for communication.
Screw driver kit and test leads.
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust 
 cleaning.
Work to be carried out
Switch off main CB.
Check the contacts for main and aux. contactors and clean it by using spray.
Check limit switch for trolley &hoist and crane movement (terminal & contacts).
Check emergency limit switch (terminal & contacts).
Check the contacts and terminals for joystick of trolley, hoist and crane 
 movement.
Switch on main CB.
Check trolley movement and its limit switch function.
Check hoist movement and its limit switch function.
Check crane movement and its limit switch function.
Place a copy of test results in the 
 crane data file.
